source.title: Call for Applicants - WRT Leader (August 2021)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new **WCA Results Team (WRT) Leader**, as Sébastien Auroux's term has expired in his position as the Leader of the Team. We would like to thank Sébastien for the work he has done in this position so far. 

The application is open to all WCA members. Potential applicants do not have to hold a current position to be considered.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 5 hours per week on average to work for the committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

* Strong leadership skills
* Attention to detail
* Analytical thinking
* Experience with SQL (MySQL) and programming are beneficial, but not strictly mandatory

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until **September 1st, 2021, 23:59 UTC**. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board ([board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)).
<!-- break -->
The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

* Brief personal introduction.
* Summary of activities done for the WCA.
* Ambitions as the WRT Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WRT can be found in [WCA Motion 01.2021.10](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.10%20-%20Results%20Team.pdf).

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of [WCA Motion 10.2021.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf).

Thank you for your candidacies and support.

translation.title: WCA 成绩组招募负责人（2021 年 8 月）
translation.content:
Sébastien Auroux 担任 WCA 成绩组负责人的任期已满，WCA 将任命新的 **WCA 成绩组（WRT）负责人**。感谢 Sébastien 至今在这一岗位上所做的工作。

所有 WCA 成员均可申请，无需目前在 WCA 任职。

申请人应能完成 24 个月任期，并平均每周至少投入 5 小时处理团队事务。我们希望申请人具备：

* 出色的领导能力。
* 注重细节。
* 分析思考能力。
* SQL（MySQL）及编程经验会有帮助，但并非硬性要求。

申请从即日起开放，截止时间为 **2021 年 9 月 1 日 23:59 UTC**。有意者请私下将材料发送至 WCA 董事会（[board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)）。
<!-- break -->
申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

* 简短的个人介绍。
* 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
* 担任 WCA 成绩组负责人的工作设想。

另请提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WRT 的权利与职责见 [WCA 议案 01.2021.10](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.10%20-%20Results%20Team.pdf)。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将通过投票选出新负责人，并按照 [WCA 议案 10.2021.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) 第 4 节，经高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后公布。

感谢大家的申请与支持。
notes: 原文显示议案号 01.2021.10，链接文件号为 10.2021.10；照录原文显示，不自行修正。
